text:
sam: Heads-up: small cluster of streams showing up as double sessions in the console. Patterns: server idle-close then immediate reconnect within ~200ms, resume header missing on reconnect.

ivy: Seen for both SSE and WS. Edge logs show upgrade path sometimes drops non-standard headers. Example: 
```
[09:05:10.000] EDGE: idle-close reason=idle ttl=60s session=st-9
[09:05:10.203] EDGE: client-handshake headers: sec-websocket-protocol=redwood-stream; x-client-fp=fp-42 # no x-resume-token
```

dom: Console shows two rows so support escalated for a customer with billing noise. Billing pipeline currently treats sessions independently unless resume token present.

zoe: Short-term: UI grouping could reduce noise. Suggest grouping opens within 3s if same auth subject + same client fingerprint and show a "transient reconnect" badge. Collapse by default.

sam: Runtime side: emit structured telemetry events `resume_attempt` / `resume_missing` / `resume_rejected` and add trace attribute `upgrade_path=htt2-ws|direct` and `resume_header_present=true|false`. That will let billing & console reliably detect these cases.

billing-bot: Proposed billing heuristic: if B reconnects within 3s of A AND same subject AND same fingerprint AND tokens(B) < 100 AND `resume_header_present=false` AND runtime emitted `resume_missing`, then mark B as provisional chained and credit B. Emit billing event `provisional_chain_credit`. Require legal signoff.

ivy: Edge fix: ensure proxies preserve `x-resume-token` and support `x-session-chain` header. Add an integration test asserting header passthrough on 101 upgrade.

dom: Security note: we must validate any chain-id or chain header against auth token + fingerprint to avoid spoofing. Only accept chain if verification passes. Log `chain_verified=true|false` in telemetry.

zoe: UI: In grouping view, show aggregated token counts, small disclosure "merged by heuristic" linking to raw events. Add a button "open raw events" for support. Default collapsed.

sam: Short term mitigation: bump idle_close for affected tenants from 60s -> 90s for 72h as a canary while fixes roll.

deploy-bot: Plan: edge header-preserve patch -> canary Fri 02:00 UTC; runtime telemetry events -> canary Sat 08:00 UTC; console grouping mock -> Mon 10:00 UTC.

billing-bot: I'll create an alert: provisional_chain_credit rate > 0.2% of billed tokens in 24h triggers an investigation. Also log counts to billing dashboard.

ivy: I'll add header-logging debug flag for 48h on a small tenant cohort to confirm header footprints.

sam: Action items: ivy -> proxy tests + canary; sam -> runtime telemetry events; zoe -> console mock + audit button; billing-bot -> RFC + alert; dom -> write verification check for chain-id. Follow up in #eng-platform tomorrow.

prod-bot: incident-note created: INC-2026-712 "transient reconnects from upgrade path causing duplicate sessions" (severity: low)
